record.question: Why should pharmacists discourage the use of infant milk substitutes?
options: Formula feeding increases chances of infection
Formula feeding increases chances of developing anaemia
Formula feeding can lead to growth retardation
Formula feeding can lead to poor speech development
record.explanation: Answer A: Formula feeding increases chances of infection. Infant formula feeding can increase exposure to contaminated water and preparation surfaces, raising infection risk; breastfeeding has important protective effects. Reference: https://www.who.int/health-topics/breastfeeding. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
